messages:
Anya: Quick status — Zephyr private deploy: staging cluster smoke passed (models + runtime). Targeting canary on Tue. Need final network + airgap sign-off by EOD Mon.

Michael: Nice. Which staging cluster? ping @Lina for canary criteria.

Lina: staging-west-2, 4 nodes. Canary criteria: p95 token latency < 250ms, error rate <0.5%, no bad outputs in 1k eval prompts. Added the tests to the eval harness and uploaded baseline.

Samir: Two open network items: 1) egress allowlist for telemetry (we need the KMS URL) 2) airgap installer packaging — missing tpm libs in the bundle. NetOps is aware but we need an owner to drive the installer fix.

Jess: I'll own the egress allowlist — uploading KMS endpoint in ticket #4721. Can someone confirm IP ranges we need to permit for infra telemetry?

NetOps: Hey @Jess @Michael — for Zephyr we can't allow direct external egress (customer requested air-gapped pattern). Plan: relay telemetry from staging to collector via DMZ relay hosts. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NETOPS-312

Anya: Relay plan sounds fine if the collector can pull encrypted metrics from DMZ. Has Product confirmed privacy scoping? @Maria (PM)

Maria (PM): Confirmed — Zephyr asked for minimal telemetry only: success/error counts, runtime metrics. No prompts or model outputs. Consent & DPA signed.

Samir: For the airgap installer, here's a quick checksum verification snippet we'll add to the installer to ensure package integrity during offline installs:

```bash
# verify artifacts before install
sha256sum -c checksums.txt || { echo "checksum mismatch"; exit 1; }
# sample offline extraction
tar -xzf redwood-airgap-1.2.0.tgz -C /opt/redwood/airgap || exit 2
```

Michael: On canary traffic routing: proposed rollout policy: 5% traffic for 2 hours, 20% for 6 hours, 100% if all green. Who triggers the rollout? @deploy-bot or manual?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy created by @Jess for Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC — pipeline ID c9872. See CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9872

Lina: I'll watch dashboards. Added alerts: latency spike (>250ms p95), error surge (>0.5%), and model-regression diff > 0.02. Will post snapshots to the channel on each step.

Anya: Also need to confirm secret rotation with customer KMS/HSM. @sec-bot any blockers?

Samir: pinging sec-bot for compliance checklist.

sec-bot: PKI/HSM checklist: outstanding items: audit forwarding to SIEM requires whitelist entry; rotation window (14 days) needs customer sign-off. Created ticket SEC-159.

Jess: OK I'll coordinate with Sec and NetOps tomorrow. Action items so far: Jess -> egress ticket and KMS endpoint, Samir -> installer package fix & add checksum, Lina -> canary dashboards & alerts, Anya -> customer comms and final sign-off.

Michael: One more — code review ping: PR #2213 touches the installer packaging, needs @Samir review.

Samir: Reviewing now, will push fixes by EOD.

Anya: Great. If nothing else, I'll close this thread after EOD sign-offs. :thumbsup:

Jess: Thanks all — I'll update NETOPS-312 and SEC-159 and circle back in the morning.

NetOps: Added the DMZ relay host list to NETOPS-312 — FYI: 10.11.0.0/24 for relay.

Lina: Noted, I'll add the relay hop to the canary traffic plan.

Anya: Perfect. Closing in 24h unless new blockers pop up. :lock:
